analysis.intent_details: Providing job opportunity updates to the recipient

responses.subject: Re: 📣 Reminder: check your new job opportunities
responses.body:
Dear Jooble Team,

Thank you for the job opportunity update. I appreciate you keeping me informed about new positions in my areas of interest, including Frontend Developer, Front End Developer Intern, Truck Driver, Sales, and Driver roles.

I will review the listings at my convenience.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A professional acknowledgment maintains good relationship with the job platform while confirming receipt of the information. The tone is appropriate for a business communication and the response is concise yet courteous.

responses.subject: Job Alert Update - Jooble
responses.body:
To Whom It May Concern,

I have received your recent email regarding new job opportunities matching my search criteria. The positions listed, including Frontend Developer, Front End Developer Intern, Truck Driver, Sales, and Driver roles, have been noted.

I will review these opportunities at my earliest convenience and reach out should I require any additional information.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A formal response is appropriate for maintaining professional boundaries with a job search platform. This response confirms receipt while keeping the communication professional and brief, which is suitable for automated job alerts.

responses.subject: Job Opportunities - Jooble Alert
responses.body:
Thank you for the job opportunity update. I have received the information about new positions in my search areas and will review them when possible.

Regards,
[Your Name]
responses.rationale: A neutral response acknowledges the email without committing to any specific action. This is appropriate for a routine job alert email where no immediate response is required, keeping the communication brief and to the point.
